verdict.rationale: Docs confirm AvaTax supports 'exemption logic' generally (avalara-docs-14) and CreateTransaction is the core API for recording taxable/exempt transactions (avalara-docs-4/15), and ECM/CertCapture manages exemption certificates (avalara-docs-11), but no evidence pack item shows a concrete API field (e.g., entity/exemption code) for marking a transaction exempt, nor confirms that the exemption reason is carried through into reporting or the filed return. Missing for 10: explicit exemption-code/entity-use-code API parameter documentation, evidence the reason propagates to tax reports, and evidence it appears on filed returns.
